findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Ek weet nie hoe dit was nie...”
findings.source_quote: ...what was Achan thinking in the midst of a bloody battle that made him covet?
findings.suggested_fix: Change “wat hom begeerlik gemaak het” to “wat hom laat begeer het” so the question asks what made Achan covet.
findings.translation_quote: ...waaraan het Agan gedink te midde van ’n bloedige geveg wat hom begeerlik gemaak het?

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Ons sien dat dit belangrik is...”
findings.source_quote: There are many things that God may want us to surrender.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the sentence to “Daar is baie dinge wat God dalk wil hê ons aan Hom moet oorgee.”
findings.translation_quote: Daar is baie dinge waaraan God wil hê ons moet oorgee.
